title: Survey, level the supports, convert the old door to W1, seal end B
note: Survey sheet first: nothing is cut before study/studio/survey.csv is complete.

title: Seal the floor, prime the steel, foam-fill the corrugation valleys
note: Epoxy floor seal: do not sand the treated floor.

title: Fix battens and fit EPS between them; foam-seal every joint
Fix the numbered lining panels (cut-outs already in place)
Services first fix: earth rod, conduits and cables, pipes in the floor void; pressure-test the pipes before any lining closes
note: Licensed electrician and plumber on site.

title: Stand the partition and cross-wall frames and fix the skins
Fit the door frame, the top track and the sliding bathroom door
Cement board, membrane and tiles on the wet walls; coved vinyl floor
Set the shower tray, ledge and fixed screen
Hang the WC in the bathroom, and the basin and mirror cabinet in the wash lobby
Assemble the fridge bay, hob base and sink base on their legs along the partition
Assemble the overhead cabinet; hang it and the heater cradle on the steel rail
note: Lift the cabinet up: two people.

title: Scribe and fix the worktop; drop in the sink and hob; plinth
Fix the hood shelf under the overhead cabinet and hang the hood
Bolt the bed frame and the side panel; drop in the lift-up deck panels
Stand the two shelf towers on the headboard shelf and fix them to the back wall
Place the sofa; slot together the table and the two chairs
Scribe and pin the trims; caulk and paint
Second fix: unit board, devices, lights, alarms; test and certify
note: Certificate from a RURA class A electrician before power-on.

title: Lift and bolt the deck beams onto the corner castings; joists
Screw down the deck boards (5 mm gaps)
Bolt the guardrail posts to the deck beams
Fix the hardwood top rail; thread and tension the stainless cables
Veranda posts, ledger, polycarbonate and gutter over the front deck
Set the stair footings; bolt the two flights and the landing
Place the chairs and the side table
Bond the steelwork to earth; engineer's inspection before guest use
